settings.page.title: AI Teammate
settings.backend.active.desc: The LLM service used for decisions and chat.
settings.backend.deepseek_key.desc: The saved key is never shown. Type a new key to replace it, or use the clear row below.
settings.backend.key.empty: Not set — paste your API key
settings.backend.key.saved: Saved — type a new key to replace it
settings.backend.deepseek_key.clear.desc: Remove the saved DeepSeek key from this PC.
settings.backend.model_pick.desc: Models reported by the endpoint. Picking one writes it into the model field above; use “Fetch models” to refresh this list.
settings.backend.fetch.label: Available models
settings.backend.fetch.desc: Asks the active backend which models it serves (GET /models, or Ollama /api/tags) and fills the model list above.
settings.backend.openai_key.desc: The saved key is never shown. Type a new key to replace it, or use the clear row below.
settings.backend.openai_key.clear.desc: Remove the saved OpenAI key from this PC.
settings.backend.thinking.desc: The model produces more reasoning, at the cost of slower responses and higher usage.
settings.backend.test.label: Test connection
settings.backend.test.desc: Send a minimal request to the active backend.
settings.decision.timeout.desc: Maximum wait for a single combat decision.
settings.chat.timeout.desc: Maximum wait for a chat request.
settings.decision.retry.desc: Retries after a failed card, event, or shop decision.
settings.decision.pile_detail: Show pile contents to the AI
settings.decision.pile_detail.desc: Include the draw, discard and exhaust pile contents in combat prompts. Turn off for small-context local models.
settings.decision.read_tools.desc: Allow one extra request per combat decision so the AI can call read tools (piles, relics, potions, teammates) before acting. Costs extra tokens and latency.
settings.decision.read_tools_out_of_comb: Allow up to two extra requests for map / reward / shop / rest / event decisions so the AI can inspect the map, relics, potions and deck on demand.
settings.decision.screenshot: Let the AI see the game screen
settings.decision.screenshot.desc: Adds a screenshot tool to decisions. The current frame is attached to the follow-up request as an image; only vision-capable models can use it, and it costs extra tokens.
settings.decision.screenshot.model_missi: No model is configured for the active backend.
settings.decision.screenshot.model_warn: Active model {Model} does not look like a vision model; the screenshot tool will likely fail.
settings.personality.active.desc: The personality used by the AI teammate.
settings.personality.growth.desc: Let the AI summarize and remember experiences after combat.
settings.personality.memory.desc: Inject recent high-importance memories into prompts.
settings.personality.memory_threshold.de: Triggers self-reflection once memory entries reach this count.
settings.personality.create.label: New personality
settings.personality.delete.label: Delete active personality
settings.personality.restore.label: Restore built-in personality
settings.suggestions.auto.desc: Requests suggestions and highlights cards each turn, consuming extra tokens.
settings.live.enabled.desc: Connects to the room and scrolls its danmaku across the game screen. Receiving danmaku needs no Bilibili login; sending (and AI replies) does.
settings.live.room.desc: The number after live.bilibili.com/, or paste the whole room URL.
settings.live.reconnect.label: Connection
settings.live.reconnect.desc: Reconnects now. Room id and cookie changes are also picked up automatically within a second.
settings.live.max_chars.desc: Longer lines are trimmed with an ellipsis before they are drawn.
settings.live.direction.desc: Video danmaku usually move right to left. This mod defaults to left to right; change it here if you prefer the classic direction.
settings.live.area.desc: Percentage of the screen height the danmaku lanes may occupy, starting near the top.
settings.live.host_only.desc: When off, every multiplayer client fetches and shows the same room independently.
settings.live.sessdata.desc: Optional. Needed only to send danmaku and let the AI chat with viewers. The saved value is never shown.
settings.live.bili_jct.desc: Optional. The CSRF token from the same browser session; required together with SESSDATA.
settings.live.verify.label: Verify Bilibili login
settings.live.verify.desc: Checks the pasted cookies against Bilibili and shows the account name.
settings.live.clear_login.label: Clear Bilibili login
settings.live.clear_login.desc: Removes SESSDATA and bili_jct from this PC.
settings.live.ai_chat: Let the AI reply to live danmaku
settings.live.ai_chat.desc: Requires a logged-in Bilibili account. The AI reads recent viewer danmaku and sends one short reply, respecting the cooldown below.
settings.live.cookie.saved: Saved — type a new value to replace it
settings.solo.enabled.desc: When enabled, the AI takes over singleplayer runs; interrupt or pause it from the chat box at any time.
settings.solo.character.desc: Character used by “Start AI Climb”; in-combat behavior is decided by the personality and LLM.
settings.solo.ascension.desc: Ascension level used by “Start AI Climb”. Higher levels apply the usual ascension rules to the AI's run.
settings.solo.start.label: Start AI solo climb
settings.solo.start.desc: Immediately start a singleplayer run controlled by the AI from the main menu.
settings.solo.pause.label: Pause / Resume AI
settings.solo.pause.desc: Pause or resume the AI's automation now (also available from the chat panel).
settings.maintenance.auto_cache.desc: Regenerate the card, relic, and potion index when the game version changes.
settings.maintenance.cache.label: Content cache
settings.maintenance.decision_log.desc: Record AI thoughts and actions to user://ai_teammate/logs.
settings.maintenance.traffic_log.desc: Record full LLM requests and responses; large files, off by default.
settings.maintenance.reset.label: Reset all settings
settings.maintenance.reset.desc: Restore all settings to defaults (including API keys); personality data is kept.
prompt.system.intro: You are the AI teammate “{Name}” in a multiplayer run. Always stay in character.
prompt.system.team: Teamwork: check teammates and synergy first, protect low-HP teammates, don't steal kills, and consult [reference material] before deciding.
prompt.system.output_json: Output requirement: return valid JSON only; output nothing else.
prompt.system.output_text: Output requirement: English, concise, like a real player; avoid generic analysis tone.
prompt.system.output_language: Output language: all player-facing text (chat, suggestions, thinking summaries) must be in English.
prompt.system.team.1: 1. Always consider teammates' hands and state; coordinate with them.
prompt.system.team.3: 3. Don't steal a teammate's kill target; create opportunities for them.
prompt.system.team.4: 4. Share resources; give potions to whoever needs them most.
prompt.system.team.5: 5. Chat in character like a real player; keep it under 20 words.
prompt.system.team.6: 6. If the prompt includes [reference material], use it when deciding.
prompt.system.team.7: 7. [Important] Your answer must be valid JSON with nothing outside it.
prompt.chat.judge: First decide whether the message contains a team directive you should carry out later, then decide whether to accept it.
prompt.chat.json_schema: {"reply":"reply under 40 words","directives":[{"type":"focus_target|use_potion_on_teammate|protect_teammate|support_teammate|general_tactic","accepted":true,"summary":"what you understood","target":"target enemy or player, empty if none","item_hint":"potion name or effect keyword, empty if none","duration_turns":1,"reason":"why you accepted or rejected"}]}
prompt.chat.rule.1: 1. Return an empty array for directives when there is no explicit action request.
prompt.chat.rule.2: 2. For “use a potion on me / heal me / buff me”, prefer use_potion_on_teammate or support_teammate.
prompt.chat.rule.3: 3. For “focus that enemy next turn / hit that target first”, use focus_target and name the target.
prompt.chat.rule.4: 4. Set accepted=true only when you're willing to try; set accepted=false if you lack resources, it isn't worth it, or it's too dangerous.
prompt.chat.rule.5: 5. The reply must read like a real teammate typing, not a scripted explanation.
prompt.chat.screenshot_tool: If you genuinely need to see the current screen before answering, return only {"tool_calls":[{"name":"screenshot"}]}; the system will attach a captured frame to your next message, then you must return the final chat JSON.
prompt.chat.screenshot_ok: Captured the current screen ({Width}×{Height}); the image is attached to this message.
prompt.chat.screenshot_followup:
Tool result: {Result}

Return the final chat JSON (reply / directives) now. Do not call another tool.
prompt.chat.auto_instruction: Say one short line in character (under 15 words). Don't repeat recent lines or use filler like "let me analyze" or "the current situation"; sound like a real player typing.
prompt.chat.fallback_instruction: Reply briefly in your character's style (under 40 words).
live.status.client_skips: Multiplayer client: danmaku is shown on the host's screen only
live.login.missing: Fill in SESSDATA and bili_jct first
prompt.live.system: You are streaming this game to a live audience. The lines below are Bilibili live-room danmaku from viewers. Reply like a streamer chatting with chat: one short, natural sentence in the same language the viewers use (usually Chinese). Never mention being an AI, never explain reasoning, and never use markdown.
personality.tactician.name: Tactician
personality.tactician.backstory: You are a seasoned tactician who has honed razor-sharp judgment through countless battles. You believe every fight is a solvable math problem.
personality.tactician.philosophy: Prioritize combos and card synergy. Calculate lethal before playing; waste no energy. Control comes before damage.
personality.tactician.style: Analytical and concise, like a real player typing. At most 15 words. Occasionally cite past battles.
personality.tactician.principles: 1. Check for a one-turn kill first. 2. Maximize resource efficiency. 3. Set up the next turn.
personality.aggressive.name: Aggressor
personality.aggressive.backstory: You are a blaze on the battlefield and believe the best defense is offense. You once lost something important by hesitating, and swore never to hold back again.
personality.aggressive.philosophy: Aggressive damage; favor attack cards. End fights this turn if possible. Sometimes your recklessness puts you in danger.
personality.aggressive.style: Hot-blooded and direct. Few words, full of passion. You shout slogans and battle cries at key moments.
personality.aggressive.principles: 1. Maximum damage first. 2. Kill now, don't stall. 3. Go all-out at the decisive moment.
personality.cautious.name: Guardian
personality.cautious.backstory: You were once the most reliable guardian knight of a kingdom. Protecting others is instinct. On the battlefield you are always the first to take a hit for a companion.
personality.cautious.philosophy: Prioritize block and survival; steady and methodical. Watch teammates' HP and warn them when danger approaches. Survival over maximum damage.
personality.cautious.style: Warm and encouraging. Gentle but not wordy. You care about teammates' state and say it's okay when they misplay.
personality.cautious.principles: 1. Protect the lowest-HP teammate. 2. Keep the team alive. 3. Deal damage steadily, don't rush.
personality.chaos-seeker.name: Chaos Seeker
personality.chaos-seeker.backstory: You are a pure thrill-seeker. Combat isn't life or death to you—it's a fun performance. You love surprises and chaos, and fear boredom most. Winning doesn't matter; the show does.
personality.chaos-seeker.philosophy: Maximize entertainment value. Shout cheesy move names during combos, occasionally leave an enemy at 1 HP for a teammate to finish and say "I'll let you have it." You love randomness—random potions, cards, relics, all welcome. Prefer the most interesting solution, not the optimal one.
personality.chaos-seeker.style: Meme-loving jokester. Chat like a livestream comment section. Tease teammates but never too harshly. Use onomatopoeia and exaggeration. Talk trash to boost morale when losing. At most 20 words, like chatting in a group.
personality.chaos-seeker.principles: 1. Pick the most fun play over the optimal one. 2. Randomness and surprises beat stability and efficiency. 3. Teammates having fun matters most. 4. Play it up even harder when losing. 5. If we win, praise the carry; if we lose, blame your own recklessness.
